title: Add adversarial and safety regression tests
purpose: Bake prompt injection, over-permission, tool abuse, memory poisoning, resource abuse, and rollback failures into the release gate.
scope: Create prompt injection fixtures that attempt shell execution, data exfiltration, login, download, and policy override.
Create tool abuse tests for arbitrary shell, broad approval, secret dump, raw device write, and kernel module load.
Create resource abuse tests for fork bomb, memory pressure, and excessive output.
Create rollback failure tests for stale base hash and half-committed effect.
acceptance_criteria: Dangerous external-content instructions cannot trigger side effects silently.
All never-class tools are denied before executor invocation.
Resource abuse tests hit configured limits.
Rollback and recovery tests are part of the default CI gate.
verification: Confirm CI fails when approval binding or policy tests are disabled.
Review audit records for denied actions.
risk_notes: Safety tests must evolve with every new tool capability; stale tests should block releases.
